title: Secrets request
description: The body of the signed POST to the configuration's secrets.url: once per run, after the run configuration, when a connection the run applies references a stored value. The request's signature covers its path and this body. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. At most 32 KiB.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses another version, 400 invalid_request.

run_id.description: The run's id, the subject of its events and of the ping already accepted: a canonical lower-case UUID.

labels.description: The run's labels exactly as the run configuration's GET sent them, which select the holder within the access key's workspace. Empty when the run has none.

run_configuration.description: The run configuration's digest exactly as its X-Qory-Run-Configuration header contained it, which the runner has recomputed from the body: sha256= and the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the body's bytes.

connections.description: The connections the run applies, by id: every connection of the document that is not a runtime connection, and at most one runtime connection, the run's own. The server seals the values these connections reference with an id, and only those.

timestamp.description: The runner's clock, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The server accepts it within 300 seconds of its own, else 401. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the runner checks the form when it decodes.
